base: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production Unity pixel character movement sprite strip. Reference image is the user's APPROVED eight-direction protagonist turnaround. Preserve his black long high ponytail with small gold tie, youthful face, navy blue gold-trimmed split coat, white overlapping lapels, black trousers, black bracers and gold-trim boots, red waist tassel. Same exact outfit, identity, proportions, crisp pixel clusters and palette as reference. Bare hands, no weapon. Fixed camera, consistent body size, body center stays at each cell center, ground soles aligned horizontally, no excessive bobbing. Single row, generous empty margins above and below and clear space between sprites; all eight figures fully visible from ponytail top to boot soles. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, NOT a checkerboard drawing, no ground, no shadow, no labels, no grid, no text, no watermark. Wide landscape canvas, ideally 3072x1024, eight columns.
